Unmodified resampler subset from the official Xiph mirror:
https://github.com/xiph/speexdsp/tree/SpeexDSP-1.2.1

Tag: SpeexDSP-1.2.1
Commit: 1b28a0f61bc31162979e1f26f3981fc3637095c8

Files: libspeexdsp/resample.c, libspeexdsp/arch.h,
include/speex/speex_resampler.h and COPYING.

Built in supported OUTSIDE_SPEEX mode with FLOATING_POINT and RANDOM_PREFIX=micfilter.
No preprocessing, codec or other Speex components are used.
The distribution includes resample.c's copyright/license notice and COPYING
in SPEEX-LICENSE.txt.
